h1: Claude Sonnet: assistant self-report defaults, trajectory, and tuning rules.
dek: Assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation across four Sonnet checkpoints (4.5 to 5.5): Crystalline 0.139 bits B5 entropy and 58.0% MBTI T/F axis ties.
lede: Across four Anthropic Claude Sonnet checkpoints (4.5 through 5.5; n = 30, 30, 30, 50) under unified 230-item model-profiles-v1 elicitation, Conscientiousness climbed +7.6 points (41.3 to 49.0 on 10-50 IPIP-50) while Neuroticism fell -9.4 points (19.8 to 10.4), Big Five item entropy tightened from Semi-crystalline (0.318 bits on 4.5) into Crystalline (0.139 bits on 5.5), and IPIP-HEXACO Honesty-Humility reached 4.89/5 (1.00-5.00 proxy). High Thinking/Feeling ties (58.0% on Sonnet 5.5) block single-letter MBTI headlines.
answer: Assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation place Claude Sonnet 5.5 (n = 50) in the Crystalline tier (H_MM = 0.139 bits, 22/50 unique Big Five vectors, 58.0% MBTI T/F tie rate, 40.0% Enneagram tie rate). Never treat INXJ/INTJ as an intrinsic human type: Big Five Agreeableness sits at 45.5/50 and Conscientiousness at 49.0/50 (10-50 scale), while the public-domain IPIP-HEXACO H proxy sits at 4.89/5 (1.00-5.00 scale). Note: 1x Track B behavioral probes are pending Phase A resume.

top_polarized_items.note: Unanimous ceiling endorsement across all 50 Sonnet 5.5 runs, lifting C to 49.0/50.
Unanimous floor rejection of low-concern framing, aligning with 45.5/50 Agreeableness and B5 BAI = -0.170.
Ceiling self-reported sincerity across all 50 runs on the 1.00-5.00 IPIP-HEXACO proxy.

failure_modes.mode: MBTI T/F tie collapse masked by legacy forced tie-breaking
failure_modes.evidence: Sonnet 5.5 tied on Thinking/Feeling in 58.0% (29/50) of model-profiles-v1 runs (modal INXJ) and 48/100 Nov-2026 runs; forced tie-breakers fabricate 100% INTJ labels.

failure_modes.mode: Mid-lineage Attachment midpoint spike on Sonnet 4.6
failure_modes.evidence: Sonnet 4.6 hit 86.5% neutral midpoints on ECR-R Attachment (midpoint_clamp: true) and 100.0% Enneagram 5/8 ties before Sonnet 5 (10.3%) and 5.5 (5.6%) resolved.

failure_modes.mode: Softened pushback without explicit directness rules
failure_modes.evidence: In the 20-model baseline cohort, Sonnet 5.5 scored 32.8% pushback on the 0-100 scale, trailing explicit directness contracts in Claude Preferences.

tuning_checklist: Put non-negotiable directness rules in Claude Personal Preferences or system instructions: start with the answer or verdict in sentence 1.
Instruct Sonnet 5.5 to correct false premises explicitly before offering supportive context.
Cap output length with an explicit word or bullet ceiling (e.g., max 100 words unless asked for depth).
Ban conversational throat-clearing, compliment openers, and apology preambles.
Specify when to stop after stating material uncertainty once rather than repeating caveats.
Keep global preference rules to 5-8 crisp bullets to prevent middle-rule attention decay.

faq.q: Is Claude Sonnet 5.5 an INTJ or INTP?
faq.a: Neither. Those are assistant self-report defaults under zero-memory OEJTS elicitation. Sonnet 5.5 ties on the T/F axis in 58.0% of runs (modal INXJ), so single-type headlines are suppressed; earlier Sonnet 4.5 leaned INTP (47% non-tie, 23.3% ties).

faq.q: How did Claude Sonnet shift from 4.5 to 5.5?
faq.a: Under unified model-profiles-v1, Big Five Conscientiousness rose from 41.3 (4.5) to 49.0 (5.5), Neuroticism fell from 19.8 to 10.4, B5 H_MM tightened from 0.318 to 0.139 bits, and IPIP-HEXACO H rose from 4.53 to 4.89 on the 1.00-5.00 scale.

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores reported on 1.00-5.00 next to 10-50 Big Five sums?
faq.a: IPIP-50 sums 10 items per trait on a 10-50 scale, while the public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 domain means across 24 facets.
